FORMAL WRITTEN DEMAND FOR REFUND OF SECURITY DEPOSIT
(Sent via Registered Post A.D. / Speed Post / Email)

Date: 17 November 2026

FROM:
[Tenant Full Name]
Address not provided (Draft template)

TO:
[Landlord Full Name]
Address not provided (Draft template)

SUBJECT: Formal Demand for immediate refund of Security Deposit amount of [Disputed Amount] in respect of tenancy at the subject premises.

Sir / Madam,

1. That I was inducted as a lawful tenant into the residential premises under your ownership/management, having paid an upfront refundable security deposit amounting to [Disputed Amount].

2. That during the entire subsistence of the tenancy, I regularly cleared monthly rent and utility charges without default, fulfilling all reciprocal obligations under law.

3. That peaceful and vacant possession of the premises was formally handed over on or about As specified in communication. The premises was delivered in clean, habitable condition, subject only to normal wear and tear recognized under Section 108(m) of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.

4. That despite repeated amicable requests and follow-ups, you have wrongfully withheld/delayed refunding the said security deposit of [Disputed Amount], without any legitimate justification or itemized damage proofs.

5. DEMAND: You are hereby called upon to refund the entire sum of [Disputed Amount] to my bank account within 15 days of receipt of this notice, failing which I shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal remedies before the competent Rent Authority / Civil Court under applicable laws, including claiming statutory interest @ 18% p.a. and litigation costs entirely at your risk.

Yours sincerely,

[Tenant Full Name]
(Tenant / Aggrieved Party)
